metadata.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
metadata.variant_policy: Experimental image+text sibling built by adding visual modules to DeepSeek-V4-Flash architecture and continued training (current card). Announced in API changelog on August 21; HF checkpoint repository created August 31. Same checkpoint supports thinking/chat and ships a DSpark path; this is distinct from September native-multimodal V4.1-Flash.

backbone.context_window_notes: config.json max_position_embeddings=1048576 (1M tokens). Training curriculum for this dated checkpoint is not disclosed.

context_extension.notes: Config-declared YaRN; this does not establish a current-checkpoint pre-training curriculum.

variants.name: sliding_window_attention
variants.notes: 128-token local window alongside global compressed attention; ratio 0 layers are SWA only.

variants.name: compressed_sparse_attention
variants.notes: CSA ratio 4; indexer selects top-512 compressed entries.

variants.name: heavily_compressed_attention
variants.notes: HCA ratio 128; attends all causally available heavily compressed entries (reference Attention).

attention.layer_pattern: Zero-indexed backbone compress_ratios=[0, 0, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4, 128, 4]. 0=SWA only, 4=CSA+SWA, 128=HCA+SWA. Trailing three ratio-0 entries belong to the draft stack in reference inference/config.json.

sparse_attention.selection: CSA: lightning-indexer top-512 over ratio-4 compressed positions. HCA: all causally available ratio-128 entries (reference Attention).
sparse_attention.notes: Shapes and sharing topology from current config and reference code; the family report is earlier architecture background.

attention.notes: Current config: query low-rank projection 1024; grouped output projection 8 groups × rank 1024; partial RoPE width 64 of 512.

moe.routing: Current config: top-6 routed experts + 1 shared expert; SqrtSoftplus affinity (scoring_func=sqrtsoftplus); topk_method=noaux_tc; norm_topk_prob=true; routed_scaling_factor=1.5. Reference Gate uses correction biases for selection and unbiased scores for output weights. Current reference Gate: text uses hash routing in layers 0-2; image tokens use bias_vl score routing even in those layers; later layers choose separate text/image correction biases.

ffn.layer_partition: All backbone blocks instantiate MoE FFNs in inference/model.py. First three layers use hash routing for text token IDs; remaining layers use score-based routing.

components.activation: SwiGLU (hidden_act=silu), swiglu_limit=10.0 in current config and reference Expert.
components.normalization: RMSNorm, rms_norm_eps=1e-20; separate hc_eps=1e-06 for Hyper-Connections.
components.embedding_notes: vocab_size=129280; tie_word_embeddings=false. Image positions are replaced by visual embeddings in the reference Transformer.

residual_connections.constraint: Doubly stochastic residual mixing via Sinkhorn normalization in the current reference implementation.

auxiliary_modules.name: DSpark draft module
auxiliary_modules.architecture: 3 draft blocks (reference inference/config.json n_mtp_layers=3), window-only attention; block_size=5; Markov rank 256; target layers [40, 41, 42].
auxiliary_modules.activation: vLLM --speculative-config method=dspark (same model path); SGLang --speculative-algorithm DSPARK without separate draft path.
auxiliary_modules.notes: The reference Transformer constructs DSparkBlock modules when dspark_block_size is nonzero; this does not establish an MTP training objective.

architecture.parallelism_notes: Only inference topology is documented here; current-checkpoint training parallelism is undisclosed. Reference inference supports tensor-parallel torchrun and checkpoint conversion.

training.data_mix_notes: The current release does not disclose training-token counts or mixture fractions. Earlier family reports are not evidence for the dated update training budget.

stages.name: Visual continued training
stages.description: Current card says visual modules are incorporated and the model undergoes continued training to unlock visual understanding. Dataset, token budget, freezing schedule and subsequent alignment steps are undisclosed.

inference_modes.name: thinking-low
inference_modes.description: Prompt prefix controls reasoning effort on the same weights.

inference_modes.name: thinking-high
inference_modes.description: Prompt prefix controls reasoning effort on the same weights.

inference_modes.name: thinking-max
inference_modes.description: Prompt prefix controls reasoning effort on the same weights.

inference_modes.name: chat
inference_modes.description: Places </think> after the assistant prefix to skip reasoning.

levels.name: high
levels.rendering:
Reasoning Effort: Absolute maximum with no shortcuts permitted.
You MUST be very thorough in your thinking and comprehensively decompose the problem to resolve the root cause, rigorously stress-testing your logic against all potential paths, edge cases, and adversarial scenarios.
Explicitly write out your entire deliberation process, documenting every intermediate step, considered alternative, and rejected hypothesis to ensure absolutely no assumption is left unchecked.

levels.name: max
levels.rendering:
Reasoning Effort: Beyond maximum — exhaustive, relentless, and uncompromising.
You MUST reason with the utmost depth and rigor, leaving absolutely nothing to chance: exhaustively decompose the problem into its most fundamental components, trace every causal chain to its root, and resolve the underlying cause rather than any surface symptom.
Do not stop reasoning until you have independently verified the solution from multiple angles and are certain that no assumption remains unchecked and no error remains undiscovered.

reasoning_effort.applies_when: thinking_mode=thinking at conversation index 0; prefix before system text. No effect in chat mode.
reasoning_effort.invalid_value_behavior: Reference render_message uses the low default for falsy values, then asserts membership in low/high/max. Other unknown nonempty values raise AssertionError; validation occurs in chat mode too.
reasoning_effort.notes: Verified against this checkpoint's encoding/encoding_dsv4.py; low is the default.

tool_call_protocol.arguments_schema: <｜DSML｜invoke name="...">; per-argument <｜DSML｜parameter name="..." string="true|false">; raw strings or JSON for other types.
tool_call_protocol.notes: Current encoding_dsv4.py and model-card serving command; reference code merges tool results into user messages and preserves thinking when tools are present.

quantization.scope: FP4 routed-expert weights; FP8 quantization configuration for other quantized weights. This is a deployment format, not proof of the current training precision.
quantization.notes: Current config uses quant_method=fp8 together with expert_dtype=fp4. The dated checkpoint does not disclose a new quantization training recipe.

training.stability_notes: Current config/reference Expert clamps SwiGLU activations at 10. The update does not disclose loss-spike handling or a full training-stability recipe.

multimodal.fusion_notes: Current card: visual modules added with continued training. Current inference/vision.py: 3×3 spatial merging followed by two linear aligner layers with GELU; projected image features replace image positions in the shared LM stream.

vision_encoder.architecture: DeepSeek ViT with full bidirectional attention, 2D RoPE, linear RGB patch embedding, RMSNorm and SwiGLU (current inference/vision.py)
vision_encoder.notes: max image tokens=384; min pixels=147456; max width/height ratio=8. No video/audio path disclosed.

open_questions: Full vision/draft-inclusive total and activated parameter counts are not disclosed; Flash text-backbone counts are not substituted for this checkpoint.
Continued-training budget, optimizer, LR, visual dataset, module-freezing policy and alignment algorithm are undisclosed.
Model architecture and source code show an added ViT+MLP projector; unlike V4.1, this release is not claimed to be multimodal from the start of pre-training.
The current encoder confirms all three effort levels and the DSML tool protocol; no training method for effort conditioning is disclosed.
